なっ……何！？<br>こいつら、倒したら光になって消えた……！？:
Wha—What?! They turned into light and vanished when we defeated
them...?!
な、なんで急に湧いて出てきて、<br>倒したら消えちゃうんですかぁ～～！？:
Wh-why did they swarm out of nowhere, only to vanish the moment we
beat them?!
何、これ……？ まさか、これ……幻影！？: What is this...? No way... are these... illusions!?
なるほどな……そうか。: I see... So that's how it is.
さっき、盗賊たちが『催眠石』で見ていた幻想は、<br>おそらく盗賊団のリーダーに:
The visions those thieves saw through the hypnosis stones were
probably of them becoming the gang's leader.
そして、その直後にさっきの大量の盗賊に囲まれてしまった。<br>そしてその盗賊た:
Right after that, we got surrounded by that huge swarm. But they
were nothing but illusions.
この階層の『催眠石』が、盗賊たちの強烈な『妄想』に共鳴し、<br>その幻を、現実:
Could this floor's hypnosis stones have resonated with the thieves'
intense delusions and made them real?
妄想を具現化させる？？<br>何よ、それ……！: Materialize delusions...? What on earth is that?!
とにかく、あの催眠石の鉱脈には近づくな！<br>お前たちも、あそこに近付くと妄想:
Anyway, stay away from that hypnosis-stone ore vein! Get close, and
your delusions could materialize too.
妄想が具現化するってどういうことよ？: What do you mean, delusions materialize?
今まで見た催眠石での幻想は、<br>結構いい幻想ばかりだった気がしますけどぉ～:
The visions I've seen through hypnosis stones so far were all pretty
nice ones, thooough.
お菓子をい～～ぱい食べる夢を見たら、<br>それが出てきちゃうってこと～？:
So if I dream about eating looooots of sweets, they'd show up for
real?
そんな可愛いものならまだいい。<br>例えば、ベリサが苦手なオバケでも頭に浮かん:
If it were something that cute, that'd be fine. But what if a
ghost—something Verisa's scared of—popped into your head?
み、みんな……さっきの盗賊さんたちのトコに……<br>な、何か、飛んできてる！:
E-everyone... over by those thieves from earlier... s-something's
flying this way!
ちょっ……な、なんなのよ、あの、不気味なの……！: W-what is that... that creepy thing...!
見ると、気絶した盗賊たちの周囲を、青黒い人魂のような禍々しい魔力の塊が、<br>:
A sinister mass of magic power—like a blue-black will-o'-wisp—silently
circled the unconscious thieves.
そしてその青黒い塊は、１人の盗賊の頭に吸い込まれていった――: Then the blue-black mass was sucked into one thief's head—
あたまの中に……入っちゃった！？: It went... right into his head...?!
その盗賊は、まるで糸で引かれた人形のように、ぎこちなく立ち上がる。<br>その瞳:
The thief rose stiffly, like a puppet on strings.
His gaze stayed hollow, lit by an eerie blue-black glow.
そして、両腕を天に掲げ、<br>恍惚とした表情で、まるで狂信者のように叫び始めた:
Then he raised both arms to the heavens, his face aglow with ecstasy,
and began to scream like a fanatic.
ああ……声が聞こえる……！ 救いの声が……！<br>この恐怖こそが、我らが主に捧:
Ahh... I can hear a voice...! The voice of salvation...!
This very fear is the supreme prayer we offer to our lord!
御魂を捧げよ……恐怖で覆いつくせ！<br>かの地を焦土と化すまで……！:
Offer up your souls...! Enshroud everything in fear!
Until that land is reduced to scorched earth...!
な、なに言ってるの？ 救いの声？ 恐怖？<br>なんだか嫌な予感がするんだけど…:
W-what is he talking about? A voice of salvation? Fear? I have a bad
feeling about this...
来るぞ……。<br>あの男の脳内に浮かんでいる幻想がな……: Here it comes... the illusion taking shape inside that man's head...
彼の狂った叫びが、引き金だった。: His crazed scream was the trigger.
この階層全体に満ちていた催眠石の淡い光が、<br>一瞬にして禍々しい紫へと変色し:
Across the stratum, the hypnosis stones' faint light turned a sinister
purple in an instant, and a shrill resonance began to echo.
その異変に、１度は撤退したはずの２人組が、慌てて引き返してくる。:
Sensing something was wrong, the two who had supposedly retreated
earlier came rushing back in a panic.
やばいやばい！<br>あっちもこっちもやばいぞぉぉ～～～！:
Bad, bad!
Over here, over there—it's all baaad!
ちょっとちょっと何これっ！？<br>何が起きてるのぉぉ～～！？: Hey, hey! What is this!? What's going oooon!?
次の瞬間、一行の周囲の壁や地面から、まるで黒い泥が湧き出すように、<br>異形の:
The next instant, grotesque monsters surged one after another from
the walls and ground around the party, like black mud welling up.
